title: Amazon EventBridge custom event bus to AWS Lambda with Avro and AWS Glue Schema Registry
description: Publish an Avro-encoded event to an Amazon EventBridge custom event bus, decoded against AWS Glue Schema Registry, and deliver it as JSON to AWS Lambda.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern shows how to publish a rich domain event, Avro-encoded, to an Amazon EventBridge custom event bus (the eventsv2 API) using PutRawEvents together with an AWS Glue Schema Registry, and then deliver that same event to an AWS Lambda subscriber.

The publisher encodes an OrderPlaced event against an Avro schema and wraps it in the Glue wire format. EventBridge decodes the Avro against the Glue registry server-side and delivers the payload as plain JSON, so the consumer Lambda needs no Avro library and simply logs the event to Amazon CloudWatch. A matching orderId, fields, and metadata prove the delivered event equals the one that was published.

This deploys one EventBridge custom event bus, one subscriber, an AWS Glue Schema Registry and Avro schema, one Node.js 24 (TypeScript) Lambda function, an Amazon SQS dead-letter queue, and the delivery role.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
